data.name: Bilaal
data.gender_notes: Bilaal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bilaal is a name that symbolizes the purity of the soul, as water is essential for life and spiritual growth. It is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Bilaal carries the meaning “Water or Moisture” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bilaal usually hope their child will grow to embody water or moisture and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Bilaal is associated with the Quranic concept of spiritual purification and growth, as mentioned in Surah Al-Furqan, verse 74.
data.etymology: Bilaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Water or Moisture.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bilaal total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: بلال
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث و مذكر، يعني الماء، و النداء، و الصوت العالي
in_arabic.long_meaning: بلال هو اسم علم مؤنث و مذكر، مشتق من الفعل 'بلل' الذي يعني الماء، و يرتبط بالنداء و الصوت العالي، و هو اسم أحد أصحاب النبي محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم، و هو بلال بن رباح الذي كان مؤذن النبي محمد

in_urdu.name: بلال
in_urdu.meaning: نام ایک مشہور صحابی کے لیے استعمال ہوا، بلند آواز، پانی
in_urdu.long_meaning: بلال ایک معروف نام ہے جو حضرت بلال بن رباح کے لیے استعمال ہوا، جو نبی کریم محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے مؤذن تھے، یہ نام 'بلل' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے پانی اور بلند آواز، یہ نام اہل سنت و جماعت میں خاص طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: बिलाल
in_hindi.meaning: पानी, बुलंद आवाज़, मशहूर सहाबी का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: बिलाल एक प्रसिद्ध नाम है जो हज़रत बिलाल इब्न रबाह के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, जो नबी करीम मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि व सल्लम के मुअज्जिन थे, यह नाम 'बलल' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है पानी और बुलंद आवाज़, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में विशेष रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: بلال
in_pashto.meaning: اوبه، لوړ غږ، د مشهور صحابي نوم

data.cultural_impact: The name Bilaal is derived from the Arabic word for 'cliff' or 'mountain', which symbolizes strength and resilience in Islamic culture. Bilaal was an African slave who became one of the most prominent companions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Despite his status as a slave and the hardships he faced throughout his life, he remained steadfast in his faith and was known for his unwavering devotion to Allah. He is revered for his tireless efforts in calling people to Islam and the purity of his intentions. The name Bilaal embodies the strength and resilience of the human spirit and the power of faith to overcome adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Bilaal represents the human soul longing for spiritual growth and purification. The name symbolizes the essence of faith - seeking refuge in Allah and striving for spiritual purity in the face of adversity. This spiritual connection is further emphasized by Bilaal's legendary du'a (supplication) which was heard at the outskirts of Madinah, calling the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to establish a place of worship and bring the community of believers together. Bilaal's faithful dedication to Allah inspires us to strive for spiritual growth and purification in our own lives.
